confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of summer prices on the Dalmatian coast; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Drink prices (cocktail, wine) are less certain, and cocktail and wine were set from the usual local relationship to beer, since direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is the least certain because July demand is highly seasonal and rates vary widely by location, season and booking lead time. Hostel and hotel anchors are best-bounded July estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Croatian Adriatic coastal cities with high July tourism demand and euro-area price levels, with prices calibrated to Split's summer tourist season rather than to off-season or inland Croatian rates.
